items.comments: Our stay was great. Peter made everything very easy and was accommodating especially for a last minute booking. I would recommend!

Our first airbnb stay, and it was a very pleasant experience. The condo was as promised, Peter was responsive and helpful, and the stay was a short drive to the Seattle city center for sightseeing. The patio overlooking the water was wonderful for morning coffee and for dining after a busy day in the city.
